lines.text: At the end of the hallway.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Okay, I'm going in.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hi-yah!
*Bang*
Neon kicks down the door and sends it flying.
She enters the room, scans the surroundings and discovers Mrs. Miss sitting in the corner.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: What in the world is going on?!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Are you Mrs. Miss?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Yes, but...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You write lyrics, compose, choreograph, and produce?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... I have someone help me with lyrics and choreography, but yeah. Who are you?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'm Neon. I came because I need your help.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Okay, Neon. I get that you need my help, but how did you get here?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, some rough-looking fellas were in our way, so we knocked them all out and made our way here.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... What are you? Where are you from?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'm a Nikke, a member of the Counters.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Counters? As in the Commando Unit?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah! You know about us?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Of course, the Counters are famous. No wonder your face looked familiar.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: So, Neon from the Counters, what kind of help do you need, exactly?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'm hoping you can help with songwriting, composing, choreography, and producing.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: What have you heard about me and from whom?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I heard about you from a colleague.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: They say you're a jack-of-all-trades producer, but you ended up in the Rehabilitation Center over some company corruption issue.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Hmm. You sure know a lot.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: So, are you asking me to produce for you in exchange for getting me out of here?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Getting you out wasn't part of the initial plan, but it looks like I have no choice.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... Haha.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Producing's not something I do anymore.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Look for someone else.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You wouldn't understand, even if I told you.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You never know.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Because there are no stars in the Ark.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That's true. Since the Ark's sky isn't real, there aren't any stars.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: There was once. A star.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: But now it's gone.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: That's why I no longer get excited.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Nothing left in this world excites me anymore.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I have no idea what you are saying.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Told you.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Anyway, I'll have to decline your offer.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Have you, by any chance, heard of T.T. STAR?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: T.T. STAR? I'm familiar with the name. They were a fairly well-known pop group that didn't quite break out in the mainstream.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: As I recall, one of the members got caught up in some kind of violent incident and the group disbanded?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: A violent incident?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Yeah. You didn't know about it?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: No, I didn't.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Anyway, what about T.T. STAR?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Wait, are they planning on getting back together?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, how did you know?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: So you're asking me to produce for them?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wow. Do you have psychic powers?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I only take on talents that meet a certain standard.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: It's not worth wasting my time on kids who couldn't prove themselves in the big leagues.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: One of their members is a friend of mine, Anis.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You should see her when she's practicing. She practically glows.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Are you even listening to me?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Whenever she and I are up on the surface, she's always so despondent and petulant.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But when she's practicing, I've never seen her look happier.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I just... I want her to experience that beautiful dream she once had again.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: In the most beautiful and dazzling way possible.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Okay. I can see that you care about your friend.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: But no means no.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Absolutely, positively?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Then could you maybe introduce me to someone you know?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I will if you get me out of here.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Woohoo! Thanks!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Are you sure you don't want to take this on yourself?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I already told you, no! You certainly are persistent...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How about you take a quick look at a video of them performing back in the day?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I told you. Not interested.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'm sure you'll change your mind once you see them.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wait a moment. I'll show you.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, darn. President Mustang hasn't sent it to me yet.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: For the last time, I'm not... What?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I said, "Oh, darn."

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: No, after that.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Something about Mustang?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, President Mustang? He was meant to send me some footage of Anis during her idol promotion days.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I've been pestering him about it, but he still hasn't gotten around to it. He must be awfully busy.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ... Are we talking about The Mustang?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yup. The entertainment company CEO.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Mustang has footage of an idol who has never debuted in the mainstream?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Seems so. He showed it to me.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Uh... yes, it's true... Was I not supposed to tell you that?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I need to meet with Mustang.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Is it just me, or does it feel like something big is about to happen...?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Hurry. Let's move.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Looks like you found her.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How about you guys?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Things went well for us, too. ♡

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Let's get out of here then! I'm in a hurry.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: All right, all right. Let's go.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Hey assholes!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You've messed with the wrong guy.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You're still here? I thought you'd have left by now.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Wait. He's got a grenade!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... It's an anti-Nikke explosive. At this range, we could all be in danger.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You planning to blow yourself up, is that it?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You and I both know you don't have the guts for that, so quit it.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: ... Hmph.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Once the boss finds out this place got raided, I'm as good as dead anyway!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Even if I live, I'll never be able to show my face around here again!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh, come on. That's no excuse to resort to blowing yourself up.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I-I've got my own sense of p-pride too!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You think you can come in here, walk all over me, and get away with it?!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Jeez, I think we may have pushed this guy over the edge.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Jackal, can you get close to him fast?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Want me to go now?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: No. Make sure you can get to him before the grenade goes off first.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Er... No, I can't. Hehe.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... This isn't good.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: What's going on here?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, just a little spot of trouble. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Are you sure? It seems rather serious to me...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Nah, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I'm not nothing!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: How dare you all look down on me?! You really think I won't do it?! Huh?!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Okay, this is actually kinda dangerous. He might really do it.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Excuse me, are you sure that grenade is enough to kill us all?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: What the hell do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: We're pretty strong. I'm not convinced it'll be enough to take us out.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Cut the crap! This grenade is meant to be used against Nikkes! You'll all be toast!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wow. That grenade must pack a serious punch.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Th-that's right! It'll blow this entire hallway to smithereens!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh my! That thing could probably destroy the Ark too!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Th-that's right! I can blow up anything! Including the Ark!
A moment of silence descends upon the group.
Then, from far away, a thunderous boom rings out.
*Boom boom boom boom*

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: What the hell?
The sound draws nearer and nearer.
*Crash!*
The ceiling of the hallway bursts open, scattering dust and debris.
Out of the dust, two figures emerge.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Endless...! Eternity...!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Gah! Wh-what are those things doing here?!
A flash of light sparks from Endless and Eternity's bodies.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hyaaaah!
Neon charges forward.
A blinding light fills the hallway.
A massive circular hole, as if cut with a precision blade, appears in the wall.
Below it lies an unconscious Carlson, with Neon standing protectively in front of him.
Endless and Eternity look at Neon.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: The target is unconscious, and I've disarmed him.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You were listening to everything, weren't you? Then you'll know everything he was saying was simply in the heat of the moment.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: He doesn't pose a genuine threat to the Ark. Not now, nor in the future.
Endless and Eternity continue to stare at Neon.
Then, without a word, they fly up through the hole in the ceiling and disappear.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wow. They're basically an on-call service. They even blasted through the building.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: ... There's more to you than meets the eye, Neon.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: To intentionally call over Endless and Eternity... what a brilliant move.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'm not really sure what happened, but that was so cool! Hehe!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: If those two couldn't be reasoned with, Carlson would've been dead.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I figured that wouldn't happen.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Those things are very much like Enikk.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I don't know about you guys, but I'm exhausted. Let's go.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Could you wait just a moment?
Mrs. Miss slips a credit card into Carlson's chest pocket while he's unconscious.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: There should be a little over 200 million credits in there.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Next time, send me some proper candidates instead of the garbage you sent this time.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Why didn't you give that to him earlier?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: He was trying to treat me like a pushover, so I decided to give him a hard time.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Anyway, my bill's paid, so we can go.
